records.synonyms_note: Toxicodendron altissimum Mill. is the homotypic synonym.
records.concept_caution: POWO recognizes three varieties: var. altissima, var. sutchuenensis and var. tanakae. Species-level source record does not establish a variety; specimen identity not checked.
records.handoff: Taxonomic name review only. Preserve prior introduced/non-native notes, learner admission and existing detailed evidence; no specimen/range/card changes.
